name: ship-feature
description: End-to-end feature delivery conductor for your product. Takes ONE feature (inline description or a markdown file) and drives it from a bare idea to merged, tested, production code by orchestrating the existing skills in a single in-session flow: design-craft (represent the whole feature UI in the design-system elements/composites/mock-pages, grounded in the repo's design system — e.g. apps/web-design-system — plus an optional DESIGN.md design-language spec when provided or present, and any provided HTML/CSS/JS mock) → triage (→ docs/specs/spec-DIO-XXXX.md) → plan (→ docs/plans/plan-DIO-XXXX.md) → work (implement in an isolated worktree) → a deferred-work loop (re-work, or child triage+plan+work for extra phases, all on the SAME branch) → gap-fix (close remaining spec gaps in code) → acceptance-e2e (a comprehensive Playwright suite over every user flow/action/interaction/menu, run against the feature branch locally and fixed) → finalize (commit → rebase → merge into the integration branch → push → clean up worktree(s)). The conductor stays in-session so it keeps the accumulated feature context across every stage and leans on the on-disk spec/plan/mock artifacts as durable, resumable memory; parallelism lives inside each sub-skill's own Workflow fan-out. One feature = one branch = one worktree; the merge is behind a fail-closed pre-merge gate. Builds on the design-craft, feature-spec-pipeline (triage/plan/work/gap-fix), and acceptance-e2e plugins. v1.5 recalibrates the conductor for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance): 'Verify, don't assume' becomes verify-with-oracles-not-by-re-reading (gates actually run, real paths exercised un-stubbed, out-of-family gates — but no separate pass whose only job is re-reading a stage's own output, which now costs tokens without adding recall), plus a front-load-the-whole-brief discipline (a complete spec handed over once and left to run is the condition the pipeline performs best under, which is what makes Phase 0's single question round load-bearing) and a report-thinly rule for narration and written artifacts. references/orchestration-model.md gains the effort column its model lane table never had, pointing at the new pipeline-wide canonical feature-spec-pipeline/skills/work/references/model-and-effort.md.
